# Native-owner cap-order fixture

This disposable F210 Space Age fixture prepares the explicit configuration sequence `cap=0 uncapped source canonical steel effects` -> `cap=1 canonical steel effects` -> `cap=1 same two effects in reverse order` -> `cap=0 canonical effects`. Its source stage seeds level two and 27% saved work for MIR's native `steel-plate-productivity` owner, calls the ordinary `LuaForce.reset_technology_effects()` engine boundary, and only then disables the separately foreign level-two owner and hides it while retaining its unrelated `automation` queue at 42%. The finite canonical stage consumes that completed source save before the permuted and relaxed successors. It records no lab completions and does not invoke MIR runtime handlers.

Only the uncapped source leg uses create-only mode, where it records `source-prepared` without emitting `initial` or calling `game.server_save`. Each finite successor's configuration callback runs during server load and records its own `*-prepared` state before that leg's first server tick. The first server tick validates the prepared state, marks it complete, emits `initial`, and creates the server save consumed by two cold reloads. Those reloads emit only `reload` and make no state write or save.

The unrelated Automation queue probe explicitly seeds its named `automation-science-pack` prerequisite before queuing research. The probe remains unresearched with 42% saved work; this setup records no laboratory completion.

Each stage consumes a caller-created seven-member source projection: the stage's `info.json`, `control.lua`, `data-final-fixes.lua`, and `settings-updates.lua`, plus the three shared aliases `fixture_control.lua`, `fixture_data_final.lua`, and `fixture_settings.lua`. The projection must copy those tracked source bytes from the selected Git revision before packaging; the generic native runner strictly compares every supplied source member to the fixture ZIP and does not create this projection automatically.

The profiles pin Factorio 2.1.23, the selected two-member generic observer `2E1BE5952D2A4CC5C74A0D149E075D247BA110A3FAE5B6768D3EAEBABCEF989C`, and the post-cap b251ae7a MIR archive `E3A65C08AC7798A66FB1BE30D24307B17C8B366DD901953BDE2A09BD6939C8CE`. The [pre-disabled-source prepared-input receipt](../../../spec/evidence/native-owner-cap-order-pre-disabled-source-inputs-09a66acc9.json) binds all four exact stage-fixture ZIPs to raw Git source members, archive hashes and byte lengths; the older 0ddeb251 and 5a receipts remain historical evidence and are not relabelled. Source, canonical, permuted and relaxed saved-input hashes remain pending actual server execution. Consequently this is preparation only: it makes no native, lab, migration, performance, or release-qualification claim.

The earlier [5a prepared inputs](../../../spec/evidence/native-owner-cap-order-inputs-5a469182.json) retain the source of the failed canonical native attempt; the corrected queue prerequisite has distinct fixture/archive hashes.

The diagnostic-only relaxed leg retains the exact foreign-state predicate and reports level, researched/enabled state and native maximum on failure. Passed canonical/permuted inputs retain their earlier identities.
